description: Single list of ContactGraph collections. Read by the three-way sync (Python and Node), the Firestore backup/restore tool and the Firestore importer. A drift test fails if any tool keeps its own list.

notes.optional: Added after older backups and baselines were written. Missing in an old backup or baseline means empty; missing in a live snapshot is an error.
notes.firestore_only: roles and members are independent per deployment by design; photo_chunks are reconciled separately against verified photo files.
